from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "The 'Spiky' Box: The Touching Spheres Problem",
            [
                "Four circles in a square leave a central gap.",
                "More dimensions squeeze the inner sphere even further.",
                "In ten dimensions, the inner sphere pokes outside.",
                "It stretches through gaps in the outer spheres.",
                "High-dimensional geometry defies our 3D intuition completely."
            ]
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # 2D: 4 white circles (#FFFFFF) in corners of a square; a tiny green circle (#00FF00) in the middle.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        box_2d = Square(side_length=3.0, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(box_2d, "B2", "E5")
        
        # Corners: distance is 1.5/2 = 0.75 from center for circles of radius 0.75
        circle_radius = 0.75
        corner_offsets = [
            np.array([-0.75, 0.75, 0]),
            np.array([0.75, 0.75, 0]),
            np.array([-0.75, -0.75, 0]),
            np.array([0.75, -0.75, 0])
        ]
        
        white_circles = VGroup(*[
            Circle(radius=circle_radius, color=WHITE, stroke_width=2).move_to(box_2d.get_center() + offset)
            for offset in corner_offsets
        ])
        
        # n=2, r_inner = sqrt(2)-1 = 0.414. In our scale, unit is 0.75.
        inner_radius_2d = (np.sqrt(2) - 1) * 0.75
        inner_circle = Circle(radius=inner_radius_2d, color="#00FF00", fill_opacity=0.5)
        inner_circle.move_to(box_2d.get_center())
        
        self.play(Create(box_2d), Create(white_circles))
        self.play(FadeIn(inner_circle))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # 3D: 8 white spheres in corners of a cube; a larger green sphere in the middle.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Representing 3D by shifting and adding lines
        box_3d_back = Square(side_length=3.0, color=WHITE, stroke_opacity=0.5).shift(0.3*UP + 0.3*RIGHT)
        self.place_in_area(box_3d_back, "B2", "E5")
        
        # Update positions
        box_2d_target = box_2d.copy().shift(0.3*DOWN + 0.3*LEFT)
        conn_lines = VGroup(*[
            Line(box_2d_target.get_corner(c), box_3d_back.get_corner(c), color=WHITE, stroke_opacity=0.5)
            for c in [UL, UR, DL, DR]
        ])
        
        # Add 8 circles to simulate 8 spheres in corners
        white_circles_3d = VGroup()
        for b in [box_2d_target, box_3d_back]:
            for offset in corner_offsets:
                white_circles_3d.add(Circle(radius=circle_radius, color=WHITE, stroke_width=1).move_to(b.get_center() + offset))

        # n=3 inner radius
        inner_radius_3d = (np.sqrt(3) - 1) * 0.75
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(white_circles),
            inner_circle.animate.set_radius(inner_radius_3d).move_to(VGroup(box_2d_target, box_3d_back).get_center()),
            box_2d.animate.move_to(box_2d_target.get_center()),
            FadeIn(box_3d_back),
            FadeIn(conn_lines),
            FadeIn(white_circles_3d)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Display formula r_inner = sqrt(n) - 1 in #00FFFF.
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"r_{\text{inner}} = \sqrt{n} - 1", color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "A3", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Animate the green sphere growing as 'n' increases on a slider.
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # To simplify the "growth" visualization and show it poking out, we'll go back to 2D cross-section
        # but keep the box and circles as a frame.
        self.play(
            FadeOut(box_3d_back), FadeOut(conn_lines), FadeOut(white_circles_3d),
            box_2d.animate.move_to(self.grid["C3.5"] if "C3.5" in self.grid else self.place_in_area(Square(), "B2", "E5").get_center()),
            inner_circle.animate.move_to(box_2d.get_center()),
            FadeIn(white_circles.move_to(box_2d.get_center()))
        )
        
        n_tracker = ValueTracker(3)
        n_label = MathTex("n = ", color=WHITE)
        n_value = DecimalNumber(3, num_decimal_places=0, color=WHITE)
        n_group = VGroup(n_label, n_value).arrange(RIGHT)
        self.place_at_grid(n_group, "A5", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        def update_inner_circle(mob):
            n = n_tracker.get_value()
            new_radius = (np.sqrt(n) - 1) * 0.75
            mob.set_radius(new_radius)
            # If poking out (r > box_side/2), change color
            if new_radius > 1.5:
                mob.set_color("#FF0000")
            else:
                mob.set_color("#00FF00")

        inner_circle.add_updater(update_inner_circle)
        n_value.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_value(n_tracker.get_value()))
        
        self.add(n_group)
        self.play(n_tracker.animate.set_value(9), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # At n=10, the green sphere's edges extend beyond the white box edges (#FF0000).
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        self.play(n_tracker.animate.set_value(10), run_time=2)
        
        # Highlight the overlap
        overlap_text = Text("Pokes outside!", font_size=20, color="#FF0000")
        self.place_at_grid(overlap_text, "F4", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Write(overlap_text))
        
        self.wait(2)
        
        inner_circle.remove_updater(update_inner_circle)
        n_value.remove_updater(lambda m: m.set_value(n_tracker.get_value()))
